snippet.title: HoloCozy – Official Trailer | A holo Indie Desktop Companion Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist HoloCozy on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5040220/

Bring your favorite hololive production talents to a cozy corner of your desktop, where they can accompany you while you work, study, or go about your day.

HoloCozy is a pixel-art desktop companion game. Characters act independently according to their stamina and mood, working, resting, moving around, and sleeping throughout the day. Collect furniture, decorate character-themed rooms, and use the in-game phone to enjoy music, ambient sounds, a calendar, a Pomodoro timer, livestream notifications, and more.

Featured talents:
Tokino Sora, Usada Pekora, Shiranui Flare, Shirogane Noel, and Houshou Marine

Features:
・Pixel-art hololive production talents living on your desktop
・Autonomous character activities based on stamina and mood
・Collectible furniture and character-themed room customization
・Music and natural ambient sounds
・Calendar and Pomodoro tools for schedules and focus sessions
・Notifications for live and upcoming streams

Title: HoloCozy
Developer: Ninth Games
Participating brand: holo Indie
Platform: Windows PC (Steam)
Steam Next Fest: Planned for October 2026
Planned release: Late 2026

Official website:
https://ninthgames.com/

HoloCozy is a participating title under holo Indie, hololive production's derivative game brand.

© COVER © CCMC Corp. © Ninth Games

#HoloCozy #holoIndie #hololive
